standards.title: Editorial standards
standards.intro: Trust is our first promise. These are the rules LËK’s newsroom commits to.
standards.status: Prototype working document, to be approved by the editorial leadership.

independence.title: Independence
independence.text: The newsroom alone decides what it publishes. Advertisers, partners and LËK Studios clients have no say over articles. Sponsored content is always labelled as such.

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.text: Every important fact is attributed. Sources are named wherever possible; an anonymous source is used only if known to the editor-in-chief and the information is verified independently.

verification.title: Verification
verification.text: Facts, figures and quotes are checked before publication. Images are credited; an illustration is never presented as a news photograph.

reply.title: Right of reply
reply.text: Anyone implicated is contacted before publication and their response is published.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.text: Mistakes are corrected quickly and each correction is noted, with its date, at the foot of the article.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.text: AI may help organise research, transcribe, proofread or prepare a draft translation. It never invents facts, quotes or sources, and no article is published without human sign-off. No AI-generated image is ever presented as documentary.

translation.title: Translations
translation.text: An article is published in another language only after review by a journalist fluent in that language. Until then it stays in its original language.

standards.contactText: Spotted a mistake? Write to the newsroom with the article and passage concerned. Contact address to be confirmed before launch.

launch.title: Before launch
launch.text: A full policy (data controller, retention periods, rights of access and deletion) will be published before any real data is collected.

community.title: LËK Community (when open)
community.text: Commenting requires an account: a verified email address (never shown publicly), a display name, a username and a password hashed by the authentication library. Comments, reactions, reports and moderation decisions are kept according to the published retention policy. Each sign-in session records your IP address and browser type; these are deleted when you sign out, or in routine clean-up after the session expires (7 days at most). Anti-abuse records (a hashed IP address, or the IP address for sign-in rate limits) are deleted in routine clean-up after 48 hours. You can delete your account at any time from “My account”.

communityServices.title: Services used by LËK Community
communityServices.text: Accounts and contributions are stored in a Postgres database managed by Netlify. Confirmation, password-reset and invitation emails are sent by Resend, which receives your email address and the message content. The Cloudflare Turnstile anti-robot check receives technical signals from your browser and your IP address when you register or sign in.

pilot.title: During the private pilot
pilot.text: The pilot is open only to invited people. Its data is kept separate from the public site and may be erased at the end of the test. Pilot questionnaire answers are shown to the team as averages and unnamed text. For any access or deletion request, write through “Your voice matters” or delete your account from “My account”.

about.title: LËK Community
about.intro: A place to discuss the news with respect: give your view, challenge, ask, correct a mistake, share what you know. Disagreement is welcome; harassment is not.

respect.title: Target ideas, not people
respect.text: Criticise an argument, an article or a public decision as firmly as you like. Insults, harassment and attacks on a person or a group are not accepted.

disagree.title: Disagreement is welcome
disagree.text: Challenging the newsroom, defending a minority view or criticising a public official is part of debate. Report what breaks the rules, not what you dislike.

facts.title: Separate facts from opinions
facts.text: Cite your sources when you state a fact. To report an error in an article, use “Your voice counts”: the newsroom replies and corrects publicly.

privacy.title: Protect privacy
privacy.text: Never post someone’s address, phone number, email or personal documents — or your own.

noSpam.title: No advertising or spam
noSpam.text: No promotion, repeated links, copy-pasted messages or multiple accounts to amplify a view.

identity.title: Pseudonyms yes, impersonation no
identity.text: You may use a pseudonym. You may not pretend to be another person, LËK or a member of the newsroom.

language.title: Every language is welcome
language.text: Write in French, Wolof, English, Arabic or your own language. Comments are never machine-translated without saying so, and the original text is always kept.

about.neverTitle: What moderation never removes for that reason alone

never.politics: A political opinion, whatever it is — the rules apply the same way to every side.
never.officials: Criticism, even sharp, of public officials, institutions or LËK’s newsroom.
never.satire: Satire and humour, as long as they do not aim to harass a person.

about.ladderIntro: Every decision is made by a person, explained and communicated to the member. The steps are not necessarily sequential: a serious threat can lead straight to suspension.

ladderText.educational_notice: A reminder of the rules, with no consequence.
ladderText.warning: A formal warning, recorded in your moderation history (visible only to you).
ladderText.remove_comment: The comment is hidden, with the reason shown in its place.
ladderText.restrict: No commenting for 24 hours or 7 days; reading stays free.
ladderText.suspend: The account is suspended for 30 days or indefinitely.
ladderText.escalate: Serious matters (threats, endangerment) go to the newsroom’s leadership and, where necessary, to the competent authorities.

about.appeals: Every decision can be appealed once from “My account”. The appeal is reviewed by someone other than the person who made the decision. There is no hidden reputation score and no rating of political opinions.
about.privacyText: A verified account is not a public identity: your email address is never shown and a pseudonym is enough. Automatic detections only alert a human moderator; they are never proof.
about.staffText: The “LËK Newsroom” badge is granted by the newsroom after professional verification, separate from simple email confirmation. Journalists answer questions, acknowledge mistakes and follow the same rules as everyone.
